title: OP aimbot for
script:
local v8 = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/xyz"))()
local v9 = v8:MakeWindow({Name="Rivals Script", HidePremium=false, SaveConfig=true})
local v10 = v9:MakeTab({Name="Main", Icon="rbxassetid://123456", PremiumOnly=false})
v10:AddToggle({Name="Aimbot", Default=false, Callback=function(v58) getgenv().AimbotEnabled = v58 end})
v10:AddToggle({Name="ESP", Default=false, Callback=function(v60) getgenv().ESPEnabled = v60 end})
v10:AddToggle({Name="AutoFarm", Default=false, Callback=function(v62) getgenv().AutoFarmEnabled = v62 end})
v10:AddSlider({Name="Smoothness", Min=0.1, Max=1.0, Default=0.6, Increment=0.01, Callback=function(v64) getgenv().Smoothness = v64 end})
local v11 = v9:MakeTab({Name="Misc", Icon="rbxassetid://654321", PremiumOnly=false})
v11:AddToggle({Name="Infinite Jump", Default=false, Callback=function(v66) getgenv().InfiniteJumpEnabled = v66 end})
v11:AddToggle({Name="Bhop", Default=false, Callback=function(v68) getgenv().BhopEnabled = v68 end})
v11:AddToggle({Name="NoClip", Default=false, Callback=function(v70) getgenv().NoClipEnabled = v70 end})
